title: E-FND-0045: the ternary tone emerges from integer arithmetic: over EVERY subset of {-3..3} the unique smallest set...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0045 in the foundations arena: the ternary tone emerges from integer arithmetic: over EVERY subset of {-3..3} the unique smallest set with a vacuum (a 0) and a mirror (nontrivial negation closure) is {-1,0,+1}, size three, where a vacuum alone forces only size one and a mirror alone only size two, so both requirements together force the three.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
